text:
Row 1.3 is now unmarked. The other four rows of phase 1 keep their marks. I ran no tests this visit, because the only change was to the plan.

Row 1.3 has two parts. The first part, that a refused council member or chair spends no retry or infra try and pauses the run, is covered by tests in `tests/test_usage_limit.py`. The second part, that ok member sessions are not run again on the rerun, cannot be tested in phase 1. It needs `open_run` to reuse the refused attempt's number and `resume` to rerun the refused session. Those are rows 4.6 and 4.8 in phase 4. A test written now would fail until that code exists. I did not weaken the test or add an unfinished one.

To close this, either move the rerun clause of 1.3 to a phase 4 test row, or build 1.3 again after phase 4.

ARTIFACT phase_note: Reopened row 1.3 (mark removed from the plan; no other file changed this visit; no tests run). Rows 1.1, 1.2, 1.4, 1.5 keep their 2026-11-26 marks. Row 1.3's rerun clause ("member sessions that ended ok before are not run again on the rerun") needs open_run to reuse the refused attempt number (row 4.8) and resume (phase 4 rows), so it cannot pass in phase 1; tests/test_usage_limit.py covers only the refused member and refused chair pausing with no retry or infra try spent. Plan conflict: row 1.3 depends on phase 4 code; move the rerun clause to a phase 4 test row or rebuild 1.3 after phase 4. Earlier deviations stand: dispatch and tally_now in council_run.py return early once `limited` is set.
